name: audio-dev
description: Development and infrastructure agent for audio — PyTorch torchaudio service wrapper with FastAPI webapp, browser UI (24 endpoints), and MCP server (8 tools) for audio processing and ASR

critical: Frontend fallback API URL hardcoded to MCP port 8765 instead of webapp port 8777 — breaks when window.location.origin is falsy
Startup fragility — start.sh falls back to .venv-mcp/bin/uvicorn for webapp, but that venv can't import webapp module
important: In-memory sessions with no TTL or eviction — unbounded growth
Fake waveform visualization — uses sin+random noise instead of real data
Fragile source separation model selection logic
Inconsistent error handling — mixing 400 and 500 codes
